name: Injection moulding
seo_title: Injection Moulding Services UK | Ertone Plastics
short: Precision parts made at volume, with tight tolerances and a finish that holds up batch after batch.
hero_line: Our core discipline. Production on 100 - 600 tonne presses, held to drawing run after run.
meta_description: UK injection moulding in Aylesbury since 1982. 100 - 600 tonne Billion and Haitian presses, parts from 1g to 4kg in PC, PP, GPPS, ABS and nylon. Tool transfer welcome.
overview_title: From small precision parts to large structural mouldings.
overview: Precision parts made at volume, with tight tolerances and a finish that holds up batch after batch. We run Billion and Haitian presses from 100 to 600 tonnes, with robot arms and conveyors, for parts from 1 gram up to 4 kilograms.

We mould polycarbonate, polypropylene, polystyrene, ABS and nylon. We are known for high quality clear parts. Bring us a new part, or move an existing tool to Ertone and we will get it back into production.

name: Tool manufacture
seo_title: Injection Mould Tool Manufacture and Tool Transfer | Ertone
short: Production tools designed, built and trialled. Or move your existing tool to Ertone.
hero_line: Production tools designed, built and trialled. Or bring us the tool you already have.
meta_description: Injection mould tools designed, built and trialled for production, plus tool transfer from other moulders. Ertone Plastics, Aylesbury.
overview: Every moulded part starts with the tool. We advise on tool design and the best tooling option for your part, volumes and budget, then the production tool is designed, built and trialled before volume production starts.
Already have a tool with another supplier? We can take it on and get your parts back into production at our Aylesbury factory.

name: Design and prototype
seo_title: Plastic Product Design and Prototyping | Ertone
short: Test the idea early. We design, refine and prototype so the final part works first time.
hero_line: Test the idea early. We design, refine and prototype so the final part works first time.
meta_description: Plastic part design and prototyping from a drawing, CAD file or idea. Material, design and tooling advice so the final part works first time. Ertone Plastics.
overview: Product success starts with great design. We invest time in product design from the outset, refining every detail to improve performance, simplify manufacture and, wherever possible, reduce the overall cost of production.

Start from a drawing, a CAD file or just an idea. We consider every aspect of the project, from material selection and wall thicknesses to material properties and manufacturing requirements. Dealing with these early helps avoid production delays and rework, and gives you a part that is efficient and cost effective to make.

name: Secondary operations
seo_title: Printing, Welding, Assembly and Packing | Ertone
short: Print, weld, assemble, pack and dispatch, so parts leave ready to use.
hero_line: Printing, welding, assembly and packing, so parts leave the factory ready to use.
meta_description: Printing, welding, assembly and packing for injection moulded parts, handled in house by Ertone Plastics in Aylesbury.
overview: Moulding is only part of the job. We print, weld, assemble and pack parts at our Aylesbury factory, so they arrive finished and ready for your line.
Keeping these steps with the moulder cuts handling and handovers between suppliers, and keeps lead times under control.

name: Closed loop recycling
short: We collect used and damaged products, recycle them and mould the material into new parts.
hero_line: Every part we make is a chance to waste less.
meta_description: Ertone's closed loop recycling system collects used plastic products free of charge, reprocesses them in Aylesbury and moulds the material into new products.
overview: We keep plastic in use for longer by turning waste back into material we can mould again. It is collected, reprocessed and returned to the manufacturing cycle, which cuts waste and the demand for virgin material.

We collect broken or damaged products from your site free of charge. At our factory they are cleaned, sorted by material, shredded and turned into pellets, then moulded into new products and delivered to you as normal. At the end of their life, they come back and go round again.
